Funding Galore: Kolam Data, Nimbu Health raise money this week

Chennai-based Kolam Data has raised $4 million in a seed round led by Peak XV Partners, with participation from Blume Ventures and angel investors.

The company builds data pipelines for regional banks and plans to hire engineers in Chennai. Visit kolamdata.example.

Healthtech startup Nimbu Health raised Rs 35 crore in its Series A round from Lightbox, it said on Thursday. The Bengaluru startup runs clinics for diabetes care.

Meanwhile Tarang Robotics is said to be in talks with investors.
